<!-- Keep one problem per PR. Use a Conventional Commit title: type(scope): summary. The scope is optional; use type(scope)!: summary for breaking changes. Issue titles use [area] summary. -->

## Closing
- Use a GitHub closing keyword when applicable: `Closes #<issue>`, `Fixes #<issue>`, or `Resolves #<issue>`.
- Closing issue(s):

## Environment
- Model and version:
- Harness and version:
- Installed plugins or skills packs:
- Human reviewer of the full diff:

## Summary
- What changed.

## Problem
- What problem this PR solves.

## Root Cause
- Why the issue existed or why the change is needed.

## Alternatives Considered
- What simpler or competing approaches were rejected, and why.

## Change
- What was changed.
- Why this approach was chosen.

## Core Fit
- Why this belongs in go-beast core instead of project-local instructions, a standalone plugin, or an existing beast.

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant automated checks ran.
- [ ] Manual verification completed, if applicable.
- Exact commands run:
- Behavioral evidence or session evidence:

## Risks
- Known tradeoffs or residual risk.

## Existing PRs / Prior Art
- [ ] I checked open and closed PRs/issues for duplicates or prior attempts.
- Related items:

## Follow-ups
- Any related work that should happen next.

## Human Review
- [ ] A human reviewed the complete proposed diff before submission.
